source.unitEvidence: Nothing shared: the two rows have nothing in common but the fact that nobody knows where they came from, and they are not authored at the same scale. Each declares its own on the row, which is what unitScale being null here forces.
source.evidence: Two rows: models/gltf/SimpleCabinet.glb and models/gltf/chandelier.gltf. Both arrived in commit 731bc65 with the rest of the models and neither carries a copyright field. Each fails every test the kit above passes - SimpleCabinet's materials are Body, Door, Handle and Top and it is the only PascalCase filename in the directory; the chandelier's are Mat, Mat.1 and black metal, its mesh is Untitled.068 and its node is lamp_lowres, and it is the only row in the catalog with no thumbnail of its own. Recorded as unknown rather than assumed to be CC0 because the whole point of writing provenance down is that it is not filled in by resemblance.
source.caveat: Two files of unknown licence ship in public/. That is a decision to take rather than a fact to record, and J2 - which is the sprint about what this deploy is allowed to carry - is where to take it.
